prova:
have hF : ∀ N : ℕ, F N ≤ N := F_le
  have h12 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → (F N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + 1) := by
    intro N h1N
    have h1 : (F N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast
      exact F_le N
    have h2 : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast; exact Nat.one_le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (by omega)
    have h3 : (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + 1) ≥ (N : ℝ) := by
      have h3a : ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + 1 : ℝ) = (5 : ℝ) / 4 := by ring
      rw [h3a]
      have h3b : (5 : ℝ) / 4 ≥ 1 := by norm_num
      have h3c : 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) := by norm_cast; omega
      exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) h3c h3b
    linarith
  have hFin : ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in atTop, 1 ≤ N := by
    refine ⟨1, by
      intro N hN
      exact ⟨0, by
        intro hN1
        simpa using hN (by omega)⟩⟩
  refine ⟨fun _ => 1, by
    refine ⟨tendsto_const_nhds, by
      exact Filter.eventually_and hFin (fun _ => h12)⟩⟩
